dct_title_s: Map showing lands belonging to the Saint Paul & Duluth Railroad Company: March 1st 1893
dct_alternative_sm: Map showing lands belonging to the Saint Paul & Duluth Railroad Company: March 1st 1893
dct_description_sm: Cadastral map of land in Eastern Minnesota owned by the Saint Paul & Duluth Railroad. ""Map shows a portion of eastern Minnesota bounded by Minneapolis and St. Paul to the south, the Mississippi River in the west, the border with Wisconsin in the east, and extends past Duluth in the north. The land is divided into townships based on the Public Land Survey System."" -- From dealer's accompanying description.; ""Created to encourage Dutch immigration to Minnesota. This special edition is overprinted in red for the Dutch market, identifying the Dutch colony of Woldwyk, approximately halfway between St. Paul and Duluth."" -- From dealer's accompanying description.; Relief shown by contour lines. Bathymetry shown by isolines.; Certificate of authenticity from Barry Lawrence Ruderman Antique Maps Inc., La Jolla, Calif.; Stamped on map recto: ""M. J. Tiedema, Agent, Weidum"".; Map in English with text in English and Dutch.; Includes photos of Minneapolis, St. Paul, and the St. Croix River and a pictorial view of Duluth and the head of Lake Superior.; Text, descriptive index to cities and towns, descriptive index to summer resorts, location map, terms of sale, illustrations, and advertisements on verso.; Ancillary map on verso: contiguous United States. ""Diagram illustrating the relation of the West and Southwest to the water routes via Duluth, West Superior and Superior, Chicago and Galveston.""
